description_en: Updates the minor version of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 升级目标AnalyticDB MySQL版集群的内核版本
name: UpgradeKernelVersion

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看账号下AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The minor version to which you want to update.

You can call the DescribeKernelVersion operation to query the supported minor versions
parameters.help_zh:
需要升级到的目标内核版本。
您可以调用DescribeKernelVersion接口查询集群支持的内核版本列表
parameters.name: db_version

parameters.help_en:
The time when to perform the update. Valid values:

0 (default): immediately performs the update.
1: performs the update during the maintenance window.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612236.html operation to modify the maintenance window of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
parameters.help_zh:
执行时间，取值：
0：立即执行，默认值。
1：在可维护时间段执行。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612236.html修改集群的可维护时间段
parameters.name: switch_mode
